stem: Both calcium carbonate, $\text{CaCO}_3$, and barium carbonate, $\text{BaCO}_3$, decompose when heated to form the metal oxide and a gas.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write an equation for the thermal decomposition of $\text{CaCO}_3$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
State which of $\text{CaCO}_3$ and $\text{BaCO}_3$ decomposes at a lower temperature.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Calcium oxide, $\text{CaO}$, reacts with water to form compound **A**.

Barium oxide, $\text{BaO}$, reacts with water to form compound **B**.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why **A** is less soluble than **B**.
